questions.question: The command `ls -la` lists all files including hidden files.
questions.explanation: `ls -la` combines `-l` (long format) and `-a` (all files including hidden ones starting with a dot). Hidden files in Linux start with a `.` character.

questions.question: The command `rm -rf /` safely removes only the current directory.
questions.explanation: `rm -rf /` recursively and forcefully deletes everything from the root directory — the entire filesystem. Never run this command.

questions.question: You can use `cd ..` to move up one directory level.
questions.explanation: `cd ..` changes the current directory to the parent directory. `..` always refers to the parent of the current directory.
